title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
blurb: Season one — ten episodes across two weeks, five a week.
rules: Five episodes a week. The windows are for flexibility, not permission to binge.
Finish a week early and the remaining days are yours off until the next window opens.
notes: Ten episodes, Studio Trigger, 2022. A second season is coming and will be added when it does.

Two windows of a week each, five episodes per window. It starts when a group's owner sets the start date, so any group can run it whenever they like — the same shape as the Fullmetal Alchemist club schedule.
Episode titles from Wikipedia. Each is named after a song, which is the show being the show.
